column1: # XML fact counters (any XML, XSD, XSLT, Spring, Maven): one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex),
# counted over the whole file. The [ignore] line runs first and reads the file as a parser does,
# leftmost region first: it blanks comments, CDATA sections, processing instructions and the DOCTYPE
# with its internal subset (keeping the line breaks), so a commented-out element or the markup of an
# entity does not count and a "<!--" inside CDATA opens nothing. Element and attribute counts are
# regex heuristics over the text, not a parse: a ">" inside an attribute value, or a "]" inside an
# attribute value of the internal subset, is not seen. XmlFactPatternsTest pins every case; pom-facts
[ignore] comments, CDATA, processing instructions and the DOCTYPE
